implementation.removed: Automatic node/vector field cleanup in mapping preparation, including partial constructor locals and abandoned published snapshots.
implementation.preparation: Inert Resources exists before either factory and retains node plus shared snapshot owner. Ordinary constructor rejection explicitly cancels partial prefix. CPU mapping/copy/DMA share vector storage while typed pin/completion policies remain distinct.
implementation.ordinary_disposal: Every constructed mapping return (source/generation rejection, success, prefix rollback or cleanup error) explicitly finishes after local memory/table scopes. Private per-call probe immediately precedes finish; production supplies an empty probe, no callback registry.
implementation.fallback: Partial, complete unpublished and published-snapshot preparation abandonment retains every remaining allocation without allocator/registry/callback/physical cleanup. Published original mapping node remains in existing registry/pin; snapshot grants no physical authority.
implementation.generation: Full captured namespace handle revalidated before snapshot fill, node publication or pin acquisition, alongside existing object/size and all admission predicates. Public callers still retain their existing exact root lease.
remaining: comprehensive snapshot/node byte/count and aggregate signed-principal admission for overlapping/retained candidates
broader caller/destructor/IRQ contexts and source-transfer/scoped backing rollback
worst-case list hold times, essential-service capacity and full concurrent hardware/recovery matrix

selected_new_guarded_preparation_retenti.qualification: One partial node, complete unused node/snapshot and published snapshot remain allocated. Isolated published metadata installs no PTE or externally owned mapping; original pin/node explicitly completes, then source backing/root close. Remaining snapshots are never re-adopted. Four allocations consume kernel heap; not physical cleanup proof or total kernel quarantine.
